summary.text: Lindsay Polega-Quigley is the Democratic candidate for Florida House of Representatives District 60 in the November 3, 2026 general election; the Democratic primary was canceled.
An attorney, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she practices construction defect litigation in Pinellas County.

paragraphs.text: Lindsay Polega-Quigley earned a bachelor's degree from Louisiana State University and a law degree from Stetson University College of Law, according to Ballotpedia.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she worked multiple jobs to put herself through school and is now a Pinellas County attorney focused on construction defect litigation, representing businesses and families.

She said her campaign priorities include lowering the cost of living, making healthcare affordable and accessible, and putting people and the environment before powerful interests, and that she would stand up to what she called corruption and pay-to-play politics.
